description: The bar chart titled “Recall@10” visually compares the performance of four different system configurations on a retrieval metric, with the vertical axis representing Recall@10 values ranging from 0.1 to 0.4 in increments of 0.1, and the horizontal axis listing the four configurations: “Ours,” “- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking.” The “Ours” configuration, represented by a solid orange bar, achieves the highest Recall@10 at approximately 0.35. The “- critiquing” variant, shown in blue, follows with a value of about 0.29. The “- scoring” configuration, also in blue, performs the worst at roughly 0.17, while the “- ranking” variant, again in blue, scores approximately 0.23. The chart suggests that removing any of the three components (critiquing, scoring, or ranking) degrades performance relative to the full “Ours” system, with the absence of scoring causing the most significant drop. All bars are of equal width and are spaced evenly, with no error bars or additional annotations visible. The chart uses a simple, clean design with a white background and black gridlines to aid readability.
